verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API, SDKs, webhooks, a Zapier integration, a Postman collection and an llms.txt file, but no official MCP server. These are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
